scripts.pack: for p in crows-backgrounds crows-traits crows-weapons crows-armor crows-gear crows-spellbooks crows-monsters crows-rules; do npx fvtt package pack -n $p -t Item --in src/packs/$p --out packs --yaml; done
scripts.pack:backgrounds: fvtt package pack -n crows-backgrounds -t Item --in src/packs/crows-backgrounds --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:traits: fvtt package pack -n crows-traits -t Item --in src/packs/crows-traits --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:weapons: fvtt package pack -n crows-weapons -t Item --in src/packs/crows-weapons --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:armor: fvtt package pack -n crows-armor -t Item --in src/packs/crows-armor --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:gear: fvtt package pack -n crows-gear -t Item --in src/packs/crows-gear --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:spellbooks: fvtt package pack -n crows-spellbooks -t Item --in src/packs/crows-spellbooks --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:monsters: fvtt package pack -n crows-monsters -t Actor --in src/packs/crows-monsters --out packs --yaml
scripts.pack:rules: fvtt package pack -n crows-rules -t JournalEntry --in src/packs/crows-rules --out packs --yaml
